label: T3
command: uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/s5/speed run --label T3 --head HEAD --scratch $SCRATCH

base.source: the HEAD build: BASE and HEAD have the same build inputs (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml, LICENSE, crates, third_party/sqlfluff, scripts/build-sqll; git diff)

head.source: $REPO: the binary of scripts/build-sqll in the checkout (out/sqll/bin/sqll) has the source hash and the version of HEAD

method.text: docs/decisions/s5-rules.md, section 5: the S2 method (the CI image in docker, one container, serial, no network, no other load; the full profile; the tools run in turn for each repeat). The lint and fix benchmarks of sqlfluff, sqll, sqll-base, sqruff, with only the rules that sqll has at BASE.
method.load_rule: the session starts when the 1-minute load average is below 0.3; after it, the 5-minute load average must be at most 1.5

steps.step: BASE and HEAD: the build inputs

formula.ratio: the median wall time of HEAD / that of the other tool (4 digits); null if a result is not valid
formula.head_base: also the compare entry of 'sqll-harness bench compare': HEAD / BASE of the median wall time and of the median CPU time; a metric is slower if its ratio is more than 1 + the noise limit (harness/bench.md, 'Slowdowns'); a benchmark is slower if a metric is slower
formula.groups: the ratio of the sums of the medians of the benchmarks where both tools are valid
formula.slower: head_base: slower than BASE; failure: BASE is valid and HEAD is not; head_not_valid: HEAD is not valid; sqlfluff: HEAD / sqlfluff is 1 or more; sqruff: HEAD / sqruff is more than 1; sqruff_total: HEAD / sqruff of the total is 1 or more, or there is no pair
